title: Pastor cuts in and out
intro: Check the wireless receiver's RF and battery lights before anything else.

complaints.says: People say my headset keeps cutting in and out.

win.label: Pastor clear in the mains, no dropouts
win.hint: The WL1 body-pack's battery is low. Replace it.

hints: Dropouts on a wireless mic are usually the battery or the radio link. Look at the WL1 receiver and body-pack.
cause: The WL1 body-pack battery was low, so the transmitter's signal was weak and the receiver kept losing it.
lesson: Put fresh batteries in every wireless pack before each service. A low battery shows up as dropouts long before the mic dies.
